pages.title: Void Lattice Bricks
pages.text: Void lattice cut into bricks - rigid blocks of nothing stacked with careful joints. The wall looks like a pattern of very clean holes in the world. Each brick has crisp, flawless edges, and the joints between them are the only part that looks like ordinary matter. Torchlight seems to fall into them.
Made in a $(item)Stonecutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Void Lattice Block, Void Lattice Bricks Slab, Void Lattice Bricks Stairs, Void Lattice Bricks Wall.
